judgment_text:
ORDER

Seeking to ensure free worship in the subject temple without any obstruction by considering the petitioner's representation dated 06.05.2026, the present writ petition has been filed.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner and his ancestors are devotees and worshippers of Sri Andavakula, Ayyan and Maakali Amman Temples in Suripalayam Village for more than 100 years. However, in recent times, certain villagers are restraining the petitioner and his family members from worshipping in the aforesaid temple and they are observing social boycotts insofar as the petitioner's family is concerned. In this regard, the petitioner submitted a representation dated 06.05.2026 to the respondents. Since the same has not been considered, the present writ petition has been filed.

3. In view of the same, respondents 3 and 4 are directed to consider the petitioner's representation dated 06.05.2026 and pass appropriate orders on merits and in accordance with law within a period of four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and ensure that petitioner's family and other relatives are allowed to worship in the said temple without any obstruction. It is made clear that no social boycott or any discriminatory practices should be unfurled as against the petitioner and his family members.

This writ petition is disposed of with the above direction. No costs.
